notes.title: [Cross-Play Support] Official Version Release!! [Patch Notes]
notes.content:
Dear brave challengers facing mighty bosses,
This is the TrinityS development team.

Thank you very much for playing the early access version of "TrinityS" on a regular basis.
After a long hiatus in updates, we are pleased to announce the start of the implementation of cross-play and the release of the official version!

With this update, "cross-play" has been implemented, allowing you to play TrinityS not only on the Steam version (PC version) but also with players on the console version (hereinafter referred to as the CS version).



Cross-play support
Addition of "Recently played players"
Addition of communication phrases
Adjustment to existing skills
Discontinuation of cloud saves
Bug fixes

Please see below for details.

[hr][/hr]
Update

Due to the implementation of cross-play, the content that will be updated may vary depending on the platform, so we have added [PC] [CS] notation to each item.

Cross-Play Support!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/865ec596e0dbfb21c4f7bc94a2de24e39adcd131.jpg
"Cross-play" has been implemented, allowing players from different platforms to join forces in battle. Additionally, some UI elements have been changed.

Addition of Platform Icons [PC] [CS]
Icons indicating which platform the player is accessing from have been added to the lobby and battle screens.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/96a535815b4eb2bebb055dc4e4c855d247060944.jpg
Shortened Lobby ID [PC] [CS]
The lobby ID used for lobby searches have been shortened.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/5154bce09f0d3faa3a9291433d39a51ecd501e1c.jpg
Discontinuation of the "Invite Friends" [PC] [CS]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/50cbc7a1ea9bd56d957f9cfaf9065d993f6ae0db.jpg
The "Invite Friends" option has been removed from the lobby screen. Please use "Find the lobby" using "Lobby ID" when playing with friends.
Addition of Item to Options [CS]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/da94ff3fb7faa5a3dd53aeae3327f57560388707.png
You can now toggle the cross-play function on/off. If it's off, matching with players on different platforms will be rejected. Please check this item if you are unable to match with CS version players.


Addition of "Recently played players"

You can check played players and also block or report them [CS]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/a5d98412158caa63c0f2cb3e9bc67626b46095d7.jpg


Addition of Communication Phrases

Communicate about skills! [PC] [CS]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/a04ddc5593b34910fb5e359f28494f12be264c9a.jpg
You can now communicate the skills you possess and the number of mana points you have. The content of the communication will change depending on the state of the skill (cool time, lack of mana, available). We have also made adjustments to existing communication phrases.


Adjustments to Existing Active Skills
Knight

 Decreased mana cost of "Sword Edge"
Mana Cost: 4 ⇒ 2
 Reduced base damage of "Sword Edge"
Damage: 300 ⇒ 200
 Decreased cool time of "Ultimate Force"
CoolTime: 40 sec ⇒ 30 sec
 Modified the effect of "Ultimate Force"
Old: [strike]Attack the enemy with damage equivalent to the hate value accumulated on you. After the attack, your own hate value is reduced to 0.[/strike]
New: Attack the enemy with damage equivalent to the hate value accumulated on you.
 We have removed the effect of reducing hate value to 0. This allows knights who continue to participate in battles to deal stable damage. However, there is a limit to the base damage, and it does not increase indefinitely. 

Priest

 Added effect to "Presto"
Old: [strike]For 10 seconds, "Attack Haste" is granted all players.[/strike]
New: For 10 seconds, "Attack Haste" is granted all players. Reduces everyone`s skill cool time by 20%.
 Adjusted to a skill that can contribute more to the party. 

Wizard

 Modified the effect of "Flame Aura" granted "Fire Boost"
Old: [strike]"Fire Boost" Damage dealt is increased by 10% and fire damage is increased by 50%.[/strike]
New: "Fire Boost" Increases fire damage by 60% and grants "Ignited" to normal attacks.
 Adjusted to a more versatile effect, perfect for fire damage. 


Discontinuation of Cloud Saves

We have temporarily stopped cloud saves due to the implementation of cross-play [PC]
Save data will be saved in the local save folder.


[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the hate value reset display was not functioning properly after multiplayer play.
 Corrected some translations.


[hr][/hr]
We sincerely apologize for the long wait! Thank you very much for your numerous feedback, opinions, and support.

We look forward to your continued support for "TrinityS" in the future.

notes.title: Notice of Bugs Related to Game Sessions
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the early access version of TrinityS.
This is 'TrinityS' development team.

Currently, there is an issue where a game session cannot be started from the lobby when playing with multiple players. The development team is currently investigating this issue, and we would like to inform you that until the issue is fixed, you may be able to play the game normally by using the following temporary workaround.

Change Host
Changing the player who creates the lobby may change the host and allow the game session to start normally.

Verify integrity of game files
'Verify integrity of game files' may allow you to start a game session successfully.
You can try 'Verify integrity of game files' by right-clicking on the game title in the library, selecting 'Properties' and then "Local Files".
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/730b2427bd9b6a4e1398c5286636f8203ff0c2a3.png

[hr][/hr]
If the symptoms do not improve after trying the above methods, we would greatly appreciate it if you could post detailed information in the following bug report thread.
We will use this information to investigate the cause of the problem in order to fix it.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1584690/discussions/0/3185737486652693093/


We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause to our players.
The entire development team will work hard to improve the content and we look forward to your continued support of 'TrinityS'.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/e9e325f9dbf5f5d17de0747f0f254900057adb59.png

notes.title: Major Update [Patch Notes] 0.3.0.0
notes.content:
Challengers! Hello!
This is 『TrinityS』 development team.

Thank you for playing the early access version of TrinityS.
For a long time, updates to TrinityS had stopped.
We're pleased to announce a major update!

The Hard Mode has been implemented in this update. You all can enjoy battles against more powerful bosses.
We've also added a lot of systems and made a lot of improvements to the game, including some UI fixes, with a focus on ease of play!



Finally, 'Hard Mode' is unleashed!
'Character customization' is added.
'Missions' is added.
Lobby system renewed.
'Continue' is added.
New skills are added.
Adjustments to existing skills.
New Steam achievements added.

For more information see.

[hr][/hr]
Update
'Hard Mode' is unleashed!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/007b8aeb09b8215fbcb3dcb9adc9ac6a1416848e.png
All the boss monsters are once again upon the adventurers! They are enhanced with vicious feats.
A completely different experience awaits you in Normal Mode!

Hard mode features

Only three-player games are supported.
You cannot play with COMs (AI).
Only players who have completed Normal Mode will be able to play.
There are multiple boss action patterns, which change with each sortie. (They do not change during the battle.)


'Character customization' is added.
A system to change the appearance of each character has been added.
Complete missions to get weapon skins and character skins and customize your character to your liking!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/da48c9bfcd8c0ac0082ab5ba19a7b4e1022666de.png
*Customization reflects appearance only and does not reflect on status.

'Missions' is added.
We have implemented missions that will be one of your goals when you play.
Completing missions earns you new skins and other items that can be used for customization.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/6c82145f52699b531a6a9b9d7f67b66ad79edab6.png

Lobby system renewed.
The previous Quick Match system was designed specifically to quickly gather party members, but it was difficult to recruit party members with the same objectives for the strategy.

With this update, the Quick Match system has been discontinued and a screen has been implemented to allow users to search for lobbies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/63a63ad524d7a8083e0acd4c6c3f9aeb38b38359.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/8c8feacaef397c604047fcf1310ccfb812dc3606.png
Lobby creators can now change their play style from the settings, allowing them to gather party members that match their proficiency and strategy goals.
This is also very helpful if you want to play in a particular role, as you can check which roles have already been selected before entering the room.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/1b7540e6eb193e55d112e91ab7e6bfe5a0c714ad.png
Lobby IDs are also available and can be used to recruit parties outside the game.
*Searching by lobby ID is possible even if the lobby setting is private.

Please use the official Discord for party recruitment.
Click on this to join the discord. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/03adfaaca645e260376a31e3968685b478db1e95.png

'Continue' is added.
A system has been added that allows the user to start the same stage again when a battle has been terminated due to a network error, for example.
An 'adventure record' is created at the end of a battle, and players with the same adventure record can re-launch the battle.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/1aa24b10b676de6e600da189149e2330e135e70a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/c9481782b4df1e6b61b470e1518f546a65e3366e.png

Many players were forced to spend long periods of time and play through very stressful stages that they finally cleared only to have to start over due to network errors. Since Hard Mode requires a longer time to conquer than ever before, this will be a very useful feature. 


New Active Skills are added.
Knight "Hate Assemble"

Cool Time : 30 ⇒ 24
'Spirit Charge' increases 'HATE' significantly.
Old: [strike]For 15 seconds, "Volitional" is granted you.[/strike]
New: It becomes easier to be targeted by the enemy. For 15 seconds, "Volitional" is granted you.
'Defensive Aura' modified to grant 'Iron Wall' to all party members.
Old: [strike]Restores you 100 HP. For 15 seconds, "Iron Wall" is granted you.[/strike]　
New: Restores you 100 HP. For 10 seconds, "Iron Wall" is granted all players.


Priest

Corrected effect text for 'Heal Area'.
Old: [strike]It gradually heals players in the area.[/strike]
New: It heals 25 HP of players in the area every second.
'Regeneration' effect duration extended.
Duration of effect: 10 sec ⇒ 12 sec
Decreased cool time for 'Divine Aura'.
Cool Time: 20 sec ⇒ 12 sec
Increased mana costs for 'Resolute'.
Mana Cost: 3 ⇒ 5


Initial skills changes.
"Cure" has been added to Priests' initial skills.
This has removed 'Forte Shock' from the initial skill set.
Priests' initial skills are Divine Aura, Heal Area and Cure.
 We believe that the usage rate of the Cure is increasing as the later stages progress, and that it is recognised as one of the essential skills, for example by resetting the game in Normal Mode if the player does not have the Cure. Of course, we have confirmed that it is possible to clear the final stage without this skill, but we decided to include the key skill in the strategy as an initial skill to avoid situations where it does not even exist as an option. We believe there is still room for improvement in the system itself, such as the fact that the abnormalities generated by the bosses are too powerful and the balance of each skill is unbalanced, so we plan to make further updates to the system, including the skill effects. 

Wizard

Reduced duration of effect of 'Nitro Shot'.
Duration of effect: 20 sec ⇒ 15 sec
Increased cool time for 'Megiddo Flame'.
Cool Time: 32 sec ⇒ 45 sec
Reduced cool time and mana cost for 'Resovaleno'.
Cool Time: 55 sec ⇒ 45 sec
Mana Cost: 8 ⇒ 7
Decreased cool time on 'Flame Aura'.
Cool Time: 50 sec ⇒ 35 sec
Certain moves used by bosses when using 'Seven Dimension' can no longer be evaded.
This skill was designed to maintain the player's passive levels while stopping the player from attacking the boss, but it is increasingly being used as a means of forcing the player to break through the boss's powerful gimmicks. While this skill is very stylish and can be a hero in a party, we have modified the overly powerful effect to be more in line with the design intent. 


New Steam achievements added.
10 Steam Achievements have been added with this update.

About resetting saved data
Saved data prior to 0.3.0.0 has been reset.
This requires a tutorial when the game is launched, and Hard Mode cannot be joined until Normal Mode is completed again.
Also, the options have been restored to their default settings, so please check again.
(Graphic settings may remain available).
Steam achievements will be carried over. Almost all skills have been adjusted, new skills are present and will be reflected in the missions, so we invite you to play the new and improved TrinityS.
 The update adds various parameters, and in order to prevent problems with game progression due to inconsistencies with previous save data, we have decided to reset your game data once. 

[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where characters receiving knockback were not synchronising properly.
Fixed an issue where the Dark Breath effect on Stage 5 Cerberus was not disappearing correctly.
Fixed an issue where attacks that reduced movement speed did not reflect the movement speed effect correctly.
Fixed a problem where the clear stage number was not reflected correctly when clearing the final stage.
Fixed an issue where combat would not start on retry.


[hr][/hr]
We are sorry for the really long wait.
Thank you very much for all the feedback, opinions and support.


Please continue to support 'TrinityS'.

notes.title: First major update to early access of TrinityS has a new release date!
notes.content:
Challengers! Hello!
This is TrinityS development team.

Thank you for playing the early access version of TrinityS.
We are very happy to finally be able to deliver the announcement of the major update to you, as we have continued to develop the game to the best of our ability based on your feedback and support. Thank you very much for your support.

Now, the first major update for the early access version of the game, we have decided to deliver it on December 23, 2022 (JST)!
To celebrate the big update and to coincide with the Steam Winter Sale, we will be holding a 20% off sale, so be sure to grab your friends and challenge the more vicious boss monsters during the New Year's holiday!

[hr][/hr]
Major Update Details
The early access major update of TrinityS adds new main content such as Hard Mode, Mission, and Customize, as well as a variety of game tweaks and enhancements. We are also making a wide variety of adjustments to the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/9b1754859b2a374dc0f02b5395985f4825db7b92.jpg

'Hard Mode'
This is a new mode in which the boss monsters appear with vicious techniques.
Hard Mode can only be played by players who have cleared Normal Mode, and can only be attempted by three players. The boss monsters in this mode are much more fearsome than those that existed before the major update, so be sure to invite your friends to join you in the challenge!
* The mode that could be challenged before the major update is called 'Normal Mode' and the new mode added this time is called 'Hard Mode'.
* You cannot play with COM (AI).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/bdd54cf78174448de9dccd715dade53151b3f145.jpg

'Missions'
A wide variety of new missions are available for players to try.
By completing missions, players can obtain new skins that can be used in the 'Customize' feature. Let's try our best to complete all the missions!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/6c82145f52699b531a6a9b9d7f67b66ad79edab6.png

'Character customization'
You can change the look of your character, weapons, and pins with skins obtained from the `Mission` feature.
Whether you want to change the look of your character to your favorite look or equip a hard-to-find skin to show other players how much you've done, customize your character with the skin of your choice!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/da48c9bfcd8c0ac0082ab5ba19a7b4e1022666de.png

New systems such as 'Lobby System' and 'Continue' features!
In addition to the 'Hard Mode', 'Mission' and 'Customize' features, which are the main contents of this major update, various adjustments have been made to existing systems to make the game even easier to play. For example, the existing 'Quick Match System' has been eliminated and a new 'Lobby System' has been introduced. This allows players to create and search for lobbies at their discretion, allowing them to play the game for various purposes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/63a63ad524d7a8083e0acd4c6c3f9aeb38b38359.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/1b7540e6eb193e55d112e91ab7e6bfe5a0c714ad.png

In addition, when a game is terminated due to a network error or other reason, it is necessary to start over from the beginning of the stage, but by using the 'Continue'  features to be introduced this time, it will be possible to start from the same stage that was last played.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/c9481782b4df1e6b61b470e1518f546a65e3366e.png

Other content includes new skills, adjustments to existing skills, new Steam achievements for hard mode, and more.
For more details, please see the patch notes that will be distributed on the same day.

[hr][/hr]
We are sorry for the really long wait.
Thank you very much for all the feedback, opinions and support.

Please continue to support 'TrinityS'.

notes.title: TrinityS Early Access Roadmap
notes.content:
Challengers! Hello!
This is 『TrinityS』 development team.

Thank you for playing the early access version of "TrinityS".
We are pleased to announce the release of the "TrinityS Early Access Roadmap", which has been long overdue.
Specific dates and times for updates will be announced as they become available.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/4c662759b9332fad5ca0b34a06c9266a8576dccf.png

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1584690/view/3335492321487803224

Additional languages
We will be adding Traditional and Simplified Chinese languages.
The four languages supported by TrinityS are Japanese, English, Chinese, and Simplified Chinese.
The addition of other languages is under consideration.

Ver.0.3.0.0
New Skills
We plan to add skills to them.

Hard Mode
The current game content is called "Normal Mode" and "Hard Mode" is planned to be added.
This mode allows players to enjoy boss rushes against strong enemies who have mastered new attacks.
This mode is only playable with three players.

*Hard mode is a new mode that only players who have cleared "Normal Mode" can challenge.
*It is not possible to play with COM.

Customization
You can customize your character's appearance.
*We will not affect the game balance in any way.

Mission
When you complete the missions presented to you, you will be able to obtain "various skins for customization".
A variety of missions, from easy to difficult, will be implemented.

Ver.1.0.0.0
This is the version at the end of the Early Access version.
Several additions are planned for this version.
Please stay tuned for more details until the release.

[hr][/hr]
Two months have passed since the release of the Early Access version of the game.
Thanks to your feedbacks, TrinityS is evolving into a better game.
We understand that adding content is the most exciting part, but we believe that keeping the game stable and playable is more important.
We will continue to place a high priority on "optimization" and "stability" as we have in the past.

Thank you for your continued support of TrinityS.

notes.title: [PatchNote] 0.2.2.0
notes.content:
Challengers! Hello!
This is 『TrinityS』 development team.

Thank you for playing the early access version of TrinityS.
We have "updated the UI", "optimization", and "fixed bugs" so that more players can play the game stably.

Update
Hate Gauge
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/a26329368050883a3a8deab752d66fc47fb73de8.png
The party status has been updated to show the hate gauge.
The Hate Gauge is displayed at the bottom of each character's face icon.
It indicates how far away from the amount of hate #1 is from the amount of hate it is gaining.
We thought that knight users often feel stressed because they are constantly on edge, wondering when the hate will be transferred to another player. We also believe that the implementation of the hate gauge will make it easier to formulate strategies.
In line with this, the party status has been moved from the lower right to the upper left corner of the screen.
Before
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/9d3acaab13055c6bceedbf1035213e4d9e941ab1.jpg
New
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/c06457ee125e96130a9fae3f4872d9c409671857.jpg
Also, we are currently developing a function that allows you to freely adjust the position of the UI.
Please wait a little longer.

Skills List
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/0511894ac084dd8991cfcbf4fdabbdb2a639226c.png
On the character selection screen, you can see a list of all skills handled by that character.
Please use this information to check skill effects and build images.

Added "Very Low" to graphics settings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/a21bdc465c0daf941ee00515ec046c66a13b904f.png
A "Very Low" item has been added to the optional graphics settings so that TrinityS can be played on a low-spec PC.
This allows the player to play on a screen that displays only the minimum necessary information, such as boss effects and danger areas.


[hr][/hr]
Adjustments
Active Skills

Reflection
Mana: [strike]4[/strike] ⇒ 2
Effect: [strike]For 20 seconds, "Reflection" is granted you.[/strike] ⇒ For 6 seconds, "Reflection" and "Iron Wall" are granted you.
"Reflection": [strike]300 damage to the attacker for each damage taken[/strike] ⇒ 600 damage to the attacker for each damage taken
This skill was difficult to realize its effect, but by using it at the right time, it has become a distinctive skill that can reduce the damage received while inflicting high damage.
Spiritoso
Cool Time: [strike]20[/strike] ⇒ 40
Mana: [strike]3[/strike] ⇒ 6
Effect: [strike]For 20 seconds, "Critical Eye" is granted all players.[/strike] ⇒ For 15 seconds, "Critical Eye" is granted all players.
"Critical Eye": [strike]Increases critical chance by 20%[/strike] ⇒ Increases critical chance by 100%
This skill has become a skill with high mana and long chanting time, but it may be a candidate for parties that employ a lot of offensive skills.
Seven Dimension
Mana: [strike]2[/strike] → 4
Cool Time: [strike]1[/strike] → 3
This skill is honored by your allies as a hero, but since you can ignore the gimmick and force your way to the clear, we left the possibility for you to be the hero of your party, but not to abuse it!
Meteor Fall
Decrease in the amount of hate when activated
Howling
Increase in the amount of hate when activated
Sword Edge
Increase in the amount of hate when activated
Blood Sword
Increase in the amount of hate when activated
Shield Bash
Increase in the amount of hate when activated


[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes

COM: Fixed an issue where passive effects for allied COMs were not working properly
Stage3: Fixed problem with boss death sounds not responding to sound options


[hr][/hr]
The current breakthrough rate for the final stage is 35%, which means that many players have not been able to complete the current mode.
We hope that with this major adjustment of skills, more players will be able to fight off the vicious guard dogs.
We are also preparing higher difficulty content for players who have become bored with the current mode.
Based on the feedback we have received, we are developing content with retrievability that is typical of "TrinityS".

Thank you for your continued support of "TrinityS".

notes.title: [PatchNote] 0.2.1.0
notes.content:
Challengers! Hello!
This is 『TrinityS』 development team.

Thank you for playing the early access version of TrinityS.
We have received many comments, requests, and bug reports since the release of the game.
We read each and every one of them and use them for the development of the game. Thank you again.

We plan to focus our development efforts on "ease of gameplay," "bug fixes," and "optimization" so that more players can play this game in a stable manner.

Update
Skills Change
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/a478155cae170123392e74a913375ab0f83fcaf8.png
Skills can be reselected after the start of a stage.
A "message" will be displayed to the entire party by pressing the "Skills Change" button on the options screen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/5b1b8ce2b2092b2c01e0a60b2242cb3729c71265.png　{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/dfd03a81c3c7a604307c169b7768c2e909588aa5.png
If the party is wiped out in this state, a skill selection screen will appear.
Only "initial skills" and "acquired skills" can be selected.

The reason for this system is to ensure that skill selection does not affect parties that do not need it, while at the same time ensuring retryability and providing skill re-selection to try out strategies on the fly according to the stage.

Skill sets of other players are now displayed
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/d76111c944b39bdfe78d195d4792bba37632eb47.png
You can see other players' skill sets on the stage result and skill selection screens.
Please use this function when playing with two or more players.
(In the case of COM, the skills to be used in the next stage will be displayed.)

[hr][/hr]
Adjustment

Passive levels are no longer reset when moved by a boss hit.
 Allied players (COM) will now position themselves with formation in mind.
An issue where Stage 6 was unusually heavy has been corrected.
The hit detection of Cerberus in Stage 5 has been reduced.
 We begged our guard dogs to lose weight because it was a source of stress for so many.


[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes

Skill: Fixed an issue where the text of the Shield Bash was not being displayed correctly.
Stage 3: Fixed an issue where a effect of "Vorpal Levin" were not being displayed correctly.
Stage 3: Fixed a problem in which the sequence of players' initial positions was out of alignment with other stages.
Stage 3: Fixed problem with abnormally loud sound effects during giraffe's normal attack.


[hr][/hr]
 Optimization will be updated step by step for the commercial version.
We are preparing an optional feature to further reduce performance so that as many people as possible can experience "TrinityS".

Thank you for your continued support of "TrinityS".

Our development team is currently working on the full version of the game for Early Access.

We will continue to make updates and bug fixes little by little, and will do our best to provide you with a short and intense play experience.

Update
Priest: Bell
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/5cd5580f00694a8cd9ce1658d114ff034dbd9cfd.png
 We decided to display the activation distance of the passive for those players who find it difficult to determine where Bell stands.
We've also made the healer a little more playable by extending the passive's area of influence.
 Passive Skill "Healing Tune" activation distance 
Distance: [strike]450[/strike] ⇒ 650
 The activation distance of the Passive Skill "Healing Tune" can be checked from the passive level 0.
You can connect to the PLAYER with a "white line" even if you are moving, but the recovery effect starts at passive level 1.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603269/7956bc8ace6b1328dde9a030af5fcef2c5731d53.png

Communication
Added "Nice!" to the communication.
and removed "Help!" has been removed.

[hr][/hr]
Adjustment
System

 Added a message that prompts for the tutorial when players who have not completed the tutorial go to the lobby.
The message will no longer appear after the tutorial is completed, or when the player presses "No" on the message.
(This message will appear only once, even if you have already completed the tutorial in 0.0.4.3)


[hr][/hr]
Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where the FPS would drop in the lobby screen.
Fixed an issue where the passive skill description would not display correctly when the party was wiped out at certain times.
Fixed an issue where a specific sound would play when clearing stage 2.


[hr][/hr]
Thank you for your continued support of "TrinityS".
